name: Test Assertion Removal Guard
summary: Block removal of the last recognizable assertion from an existing test file.
description: Compares bounded test-file revisions and stops a change when recognizable tests remain but all assertion or failure primitives disappear from a previously asserting file.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks removal of the last recognizable assertion from an existing test file; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not judge assertion quality or test coverage.
It does not block assertion-preserving refactors recognized by its bounded vocabulary.
It does not govern skipped or deleted test cases.

entrypoints.purpose: Block removal of the last recognizable assertion from an existing test file.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block removal of the last recognizable assertion from an existing test file without deferred work.
